frozenSources.role: the toNumChapter member (lines 905-913) exposed to rule scripts as java.toNumChapter; transcribed into the harness because this file names Rhino, AppConfig and Android types and cannot be compiled on a desktop JVM
titleNumPattern = (第)(.+?)(章), compiled from the frozen bytes by the harness
stringToInt / fullToHalf / chineseNumToInt / chnMap, compiled from the frozen bytes by the harness

note: Frozen inputs for java.toNumChapter. The harness calls the frozen AppPattern.titleNumPattern and the frozen StringUtils.stringToInt for every row, and refuses a row whose two runs differ. Notes name the frozen branch a row reaches, not the answer: the golden holds the answer.

cases.name: digits-plain
cases.input: 第一百二十三章 后文
cases.note: chineseNumToInt's ordinary branch: 一 二 三 accumulate as tmp*10 + digit, so the counter is 123.

cases.name: shorthand-thousand-two
cases.note: The trailing-shorthand branch (StringUtils.kt:194-197): a single digit after a >10 unit is tmpNum * previousUnit / 10.

cases.name: formal-numerals
cases.note: The 〇壹贰叁肆伍陆柒捌玖拾 row of chnMap, with a zero placeholder between units.

cases.name: two-variant
cases.note: chnMap['两'] = 2 (StringUtils.kt:43), the one numeral outside the two chnMap strings.

cases.name: hundred-million
cases.note: The 亿 branch folds result+billion and then the 万 branch multiplies again.

cases.name: digit-sequence
cases.note: Every mapped numeral is below ten, so the accumulate branch reads the string as a digit sequence: 123.

cases.name: fullwidth-digits
cases.note: fullToHalf folds ６５２８１..６５３７４ to ASCII before Integer.parseInt sees the group.

cases.name: fullwidth-space-and-sign
cases.note: U+3000 becomes a space and the whitespace strip removes it, leaving the PHP-style '+' sign Integer.parseInt accepts.

cases.name: zero
cases.note: The zero numeral, not the empty string: chineseNumToInt returns 0.

cases.name: blank-group
cases.note: (.+?) matches the space, so the title row matches; the strip leaves an empty string, parseInt throws and chineseNumToInt('') adds nothing, returning 0.

cases.name: digits-plain-ascii
cases.note: Integer.parseInt succeeds on the first try, so chineseNumToInt is never entered.

cases.name: negative-number
cases.note: A sign Integer.parseInt accepts inside the matched group.

cases.name: decimal-unparsable
cases.note: ASCII digits with a dot: parseInt throws, then chnMap['.'] is absent and the NoSuchElementException is runCatching's default -1.

cases.name: unparsable-latin
cases.note: Same fallback with Latin letters and a stripped space.

cases.name: int-max-plus-one
cases.note: Integer.parseInt rejects the value, and chnMap has no ASCII digit: -1.

cases.name: int-overflow-wraps
cases.note: The 亿 branch multiplies into a 32-bit Int and the frozen arithmetic wraps: this row is why the port must not use a wider integer.

cases.name: lone-ten-thousand
cases.note: A unit with no digit before it: the 万 branch multiplies tmp, which is still 0.

cases.name: lone-ten
cases.note: The tmpNum >= 10 branch seeds tmp with 1 when no digit precedes the unit.

cases.name: lone-hundred
cases.note: The same seeding for 百, whose value is 100 rather than 10.

cases.name: lazy-first-match-wins
cases.note: find() takes the first match and (.+?) is lazy, so the match is 第一章; the row is rebuilt from the three groups alone, so everything after that 章 is dropped from the title.

cases.name: first-token-wins-across-titles
cases.input: 第一卷 第十二章 起点
cases.note: The first 第 pairs with the first 章, so the group is a title fragment rather than a numeral: the fallback runs and the tail after 章 is dropped.

cases.name: no-match-unchanged
cases.note: No 第: the input is returned untouched.

cases.name: no-match-empty-title
cases.note: (.+?) needs at least one character, so 第章 has no match and is returned untouched.

cases.name: no-match-ascii
cases.note: The pattern never matches, so a title that is not Chinese chapter-marked is a pass-through row.

cases.name: empty-input
cases.note: The empty string, which is not the null row: the pattern does not match and the empty string is returned.

cases.name: null-input
cases.note: The `s ?: return null` guard; a null argument stays null instead of becoming an error or a string.
